about.title: About Personal Loan Calculator - Unsecured Loan Planning Tool
about.description: The Personal Loan Calculator is a comprehensive borrowing tool designed to help you calculate monthly payments, total costs, and affordability for personal loans. This calculator helps you compare loan offers, determine optimal loan terms, and understand the total cost of borrowing for debt consolidation, home improvements, or major purchases. Whether you're considering fixed-rate personal loans or comparing lenders, this tool provides accurate loan projections.

faq.q: What's a good interest rate for a personal loan?
faq.a: Personal loan rates typically range from 6% to 36% depending on your credit score, income, and lender. Excellent credit (720+) may qualify for rates as low as 6-10%, while fair credit (580-669) might see rates of 18-25%.

faq.q: How much can I borrow with a personal loan?
faq.a: Personal loan amounts typically range from $1,000 to $100,000, depending on the lender and your creditworthiness. Most lenders consider your debt-to-income ratio and require it to be below 40-50% including the new loan payment.

faq.q: What loan term should I choose?
faq.a: Shorter terms (2-3 years) have higher monthly payments but lower total interest costs. Longer terms (5-7 years) have lower monthly payments but higher total costs. Choose based on your monthly budget and total cost preference.

faq.q: Should I use a personal loan for debt consolidation?
faq.a: Personal loans can be effective for debt consolidation if you qualify for a lower interest rate than your current debts. This simplifies payments and can save money, but requires discipline to avoid accumulating new debt.
